title: PetChain Simulation Fixtures
description: Schema for deterministic transaction simulation fixtures used by client repositories for pre-signing UX.

fixture_version.description: Semantic version of the fixture format.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the fixtures were generated.

source_commit.description: Git commit hash or HEAD reference used to generate these fixtures.

description.description: Human-readable description of the fixture set.

fixture_id.description: Unique identifier for this simulation fixture.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this simulation tests.

function.description: Name of the contract function being simulated.

params.description: Input parameters for the simulated function call.

result.description: Whether the simulated transaction succeeds or fails.

error_code.description: ContractError discriminant code when result is failure.

error_name.description: ContractError variant name corresponding to error_code.

error_type.description: Non-contract error type (e.g. resource_exhaustion for budget failures).

steps.description: Estimated compute steps consumed by the transaction.

read_entries.description: Estimated number of storage entries read.

write_entries.description: Estimated number of storage entries written.

exceeds_budget.description: Whether the estimated steps exceed the Soroban budget limit.

budget_limit_steps.description: The Soroban step budget limit for reference.
